cabinCategories.description: Cozy interior cabin with all essentials — Carnival's unbeatable value for Alaska. Twin or queen beds with thoughtful storage.
Ocean view cabin with large window — catch Alaska's spectacular coastline from your own room at Carnival's best value.
Private balcony cabin — ideal for watching for humpback whales and eagles from your own outdoor space on sea days.
Grand Suite with separate living room, priority boarding, and an enhanced room service menu — Carnival's best at an unmatched price.

inclusions: All meals in main dining and Lido deck

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Carnival Miracle delivers legendary fun-ship value on a 7-night Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A wonderful scenic day cruising the Inside Passage. Alaska's wilderness unfolds outside while Carnival Miracle's full slate of fun activities keeps the energy high.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital city — Mendenhall Glacier and the whale watching of Auke Bay are the standout experiences. The city's waterfront has excellent local seafood.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Klondike Gold Rush National Historic Park comes alive in Skagway. Ride the legendary White Pass & Yukon Route Railway through mountain passes once traveled by gold seekers.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Creek Street, totem pole parks, and outstanding fresh crab — Carnival Miracle guests get ample time to explore Ketchikan's highlights.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: Evening arrival in Victoria BC — the Inner Harbour at night is one of the most scenic sights in the Pacific Northwest.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: "Carnival Miracle is everything you need for an Alaska cruise at a price you can actually afford. We saw humpback whales right from the deck — for free! — and had an absolute blast on board." — Verified Guest
